title: SessionWindow
description: Per-pattern session-window rule the Correlation Engine uses to govern each correlation instance's lifetime. An authored operational directive derived and populated by the Pattern Manager from the mined timing statistics — distinct from the descriptive `timing` field. Shared identically by PatternDiscoveredEvent and PatternApprovedEvent.

windowMs.description: Session-window duration in milliseconds; how long a correlation instance for this pattern is held open awaiting a satisfying match before it expires.

type.description: Window semantics: 'gap-based' (window resets/extends on each new matching alarm — an idle gap closes it) or 'fixed' (window is a fixed duration from instance start).
